title: nexus.io.agui
description: AG-UI serve transport. Every key here is read by Init in plugins/io/agui/plugin.go; the auth block is parsed by pkg/nexusauth, shared with cmd/nexus-broker.

bind.description: host:port the HTTP listener binds to. Default 127.0.0.1:8090 (loopback), so the endpoint is not network-exposed without explicit opt-in. Init falls back to the default on an empty string, so no minLength is imposed here.

bearer_token.description: Inline bearer token, desugared into a one-entry static validator. Takes precedence over bearer_token_env. Mutually exclusive with auth — that conflict is enforced in Init, which owns the operator-facing message; it is deliberately NOT duplicated here so the two enforcement points cannot drift.

bearer_token_env.description: Name of an environment variable holding the bearer token. Consulted only when bearer_token is empty. Mutually exclusive with auth (see bearer_token).

cors_origins.description: Allowed CORS origins. A YAML list, or a single comma-separated string (parseCORSOrigins splits on commas and trims). A lone "*" echoes any request Origin. Empty means no CORS header at all (same-origin only).

emit_state.description: Opt-in AG-UI shared-state emission: mirrors the session's scene store as a shared-state document (StateSnapshot at run start, ordered StateDelta per mutation). Default false.

auth.description: Validator-chain block, parsed by pkg/nexusauth.ChainFromMap — the same parser the session broker uses. `validators` is its only key: `admin_scope` is broker-only and is rejected here. Writing `auth:` with no value is the same as omitting it.

validators.description: Validators to try, in order; the first that accepts wins. Absent, null or empty means authentication is disabled.

validator.description: One validators[] entry. The per-type keys are described by the if/then branches below rather than by one flat property list, because additionalProperties only sees properties declared in the same schema object — a flat list would have to allow every type's keys on every type, which is exactly the silent-typo hole this schema exists to close.

staticValidator.description: type: static — a table of shared bearer tokens, compared in constant time.

principal_claim.description: Accepted and ignored: a static token carries no claim set.

tokens.description: At least one entry. Duplicate token values are a config error, not last-one-wins.

principal.description: The principal id a request presenting this token acts as. Must be non-empty — an empty id behaves as a wildcard in ownership checks.

scopes.description: Optional granted scopes. A string is split on whitespace; a list is taken verbatim.

jwksValidator.description: type: jwks — OIDC JWTs verified against the issuer's published key set. Generic OIDC: no provider-specific defaults, so principal_claim has no fallback guess.

principal_claim.description: Required: the claim that becomes Principal.ID.

tenant_claim.description: Optional: the claim that becomes Principal.Tenant.

scopes_claim.description: Optional: the claim that becomes Principal.Scopes.

issuer.description: The exact value the token's iss claim must carry. Compared as an opaque string, trailing slash included.

jwks_url.description: The issuer's JWKS endpoint. Must be absolute https, except to a loopback host.

audience.description: Acceptable aud values; a token carrying any of them passes. A lone string is one audience and is not split on whitespace.

algorithms.description: Accepted JWS algorithms. Default ["RS256"]. Asymmetric only — `none` and the HMAC family are not configurable at all.

cache_ttl.description: How long a fetched key set is fresh. Default 10m.

negative_cache_ttl.description: How long an unresolvable kid is remembered, and the minimum interval between on-demand fetches. Default 1m.

http_timeout.description: Bounds a single JWKS request. Default 5s.

clock_skew.description: Leeway applied to exp and nbf. Default 1m, capped at 5m.

introspectValidator.description: type: introspect — opaque tokens verified by calling the issuer's RFC 7662 introspection endpoint.

principal_claim.description: Required: the claim that becomes Principal.ID.

tenant_claim.description: Optional: the claim that becomes Principal.Tenant.

scopes_claim.description: Optional: the claim that becomes Principal.Scopes.

introspection_url.description: The RFC 7662 endpoint. Must be absolute https, except to a loopback host.

client_id.description: Required: the client id presented to the introspection endpoint.

client_secret.description: The client secret written inline. Mutually exclusive with client_secret_env.

client_secret_env.description: The NAME of an environment variable holding the client secret. Mutually exclusive with client_secret; a named variable that is unset or empty fails the boot.

client_auth.description: How the client credentials are presented. Default basic.

token_type_hint.description: The optional RFC 7662 §2.1 token_type_hint parameter. Default access_token; set to "" to send no hint.

cache_ttl.description: Maximum lifetime of a cached verdict. Default 1m, capped at 15m.

negative_cache_ttl.description: How long a definitive refusal is remembered. Default 30s, capped at 15m.

http_timeout.description: Bounds a single introspection request. Default 5s.

proxyHeadersValidator.description: type: proxy_headers — an identity a fronting authenticating proxy already established, honoured only for peers inside the CIDR allowlist.

principal_claim.description: Accepted and ignored: there is no claim set here, only headers.

trusted_proxy_cidrs.description: Required and non-empty: the networks whose peers may assert an identity through headers. This allowlist IS the security model — never 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0.

principal_header.description: Required: the header whose value becomes Principal.ID. No default is right for everyone.

tenant_header.description: Optional header whose value becomes Principal.Tenant.

scopes_header.description: Optional header whose value becomes Principal.Scopes, split on commas and/or whitespace.

stringOrStringList.description: A single string or a list of strings — both spellings the nexusauth/agui parsers accept.

duration.description: A Go duration string such as "10m", "30s" or "1h30m". A bare number is rejected on purpose: 600 reads as ten minutes to an operator and six hundred nanoseconds to Go.
